body.name: local collision power-envelope handle
body.construction: Construct factorization-preserving local paths in each semialgebraic classification stratum through a profile collision, derive their Gaussian covariance local asymptotic normal experiment in the norm \(\lVert\cdot\rVert_{I,n,\theta}\), and reduce optimal honest certification of \(h(\theta)\) to testing the resulting finite union of tangent cones in order to determine \(\beta^{\star}(c)\).
